host: owner MacBook Pro, Apple M2 Pro, 32 GB, macOS 27
subject: synapse tokenize (repo-owned byte-level BPE, qwen2 pre-tokenizer, vocabulary from GGUF arrays)

corpus.description: Every tracked and new text file of the working tree with extensions md, cs, rs, metal, cu, cuh, toml, yml, props, json, excluding _external/ and artifacts/, each under 400 KB

pitfalls: Without --no-escape, llama-tokenize rewrites literal \n into a newline: .github/workflows/performance.yml diverged at token 2935 (198 versus 1699) until --no-escape was added. The difference was in the reference tool's input handling, not in the tokenizer.
llama.cpp -f (llama-completion, llama-perplexity) drops one trailing newline of the prompt file; llama-tokenize does not.

corpusAll.build: git ls-tree -r --name-only b090e95 | grep -E '\.(md|cs|rs)$' | grep -v -E '^(_external|artifacts)/' | sort, then git show b090e95:<file> followed by one newline, concatenated

haystack.build: the 38 *.md files of b090e95 in sorted order, then the *.cs and *.rs files in sorted order, each followed by one newline
